home.descriptionText: Credentials are issued with the OpenID4VCI pre-authorized code flow. Once the citizen’s identity has been verified against the national register, the portal creates a credential offer and displays it as a QR code. The citizen scans it with the ANIP Wallet, which connects securely to the issuer, redeems the pre-authorized code and stores the verifiable credential on the phone, without any browser-based login.
home.heroTitle: Issue digital credentials to citizens’ ANIP Wallets
home.selectUseCaseHint: Choose the service you want to use to issue a credential.
home.step1: Choose a credential and select the citizen’s pre-authorized record.
home.step2: Verify the citizen’s identity with their date of birth and NPI.
home.step3: The citizen scans the QR code with their ANIP Wallet to receive the credential.
home.heroLead: Verify the citizen’s identity, then securely issue their digital identity card or birth certificate to the ANIP Wallet.
